data.name: Mahita
data.gender_notes: Mahita is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mahita is derived from the Sanskrit word 'mah,' meaning great or mighty. This name is often given to girls born into respected or powerful families. The name Mahita carries the meaning “Great, Mighty” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mahita usually hope their child will grow to embody great, mighty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Mahita belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Great, Mighty.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mahita total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
